content.text:
This confirms the bug definitively: the same commit that introduced the switch statement also defined the correct per-type properties (`ReservationPriorityGroup`, `ReservationPriorityCourse`, `ReservationPriorityCurriculum`, etc.), but the switch-case bodies for `Group`, `Curriculum`, and `Course` mistakenly all called the `...Individual` variants instead of their own — a clear copy-paste error within a single commit.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 18f154d85110c36f6eb403d0a33703db4cfe8175

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the file history of `XReservation.java` with `git log -p --follow` to find when the switch statement (that commit 6eb8807d fixes) was first introduced, searching for occurrences of `ReservationPriorityIndividual` combined with `case Group`/`case Curriculum`/`case Course`.

**(2) Specific change:** Commit `18f154d8` (Dec 5, 2014, "Tomáš Müller") added the `switch (type)` block in `XReservation`'s constructor that sets priority/overLimit/mustBeUsed/allowOverlap flags based on reservation type. In the same commit, it also added the corresponding `ApplicationProperty` enum constants (`ReservationPriorityGroup`, `ReservationPriorityCurriculum`, `ReservationPriorityCourse`, and their `CanOverLimit`/`MustBeUsed`/`AllowOverlap` counterparts). However, the `case Group:`, `case Curriculum:`, and `case Course:` branches were all copy-pasted from `case Individual:` and never updated to reference their own type-specific properties — they all called `...Individual` variants instead.

**(3) Evidence:** 
- `git show 18f154d8 -- .../XReservation.java` shows the switch statement was added wholesale in this commit, with all four non-Individual, non-Override branches (`Group`, `Curriculum`, `Course`) using `ReservationPriorityIndividual`/`ReservationCanOverLimitIndividual`/`ReservationMustBeUsedIndividual`/`ReservationAllowOverlapIndividual`.
- The same commit's diff to `ApplicationProperty.java` shows the type-specific properties (`...Group`, `...Curriculum`, `...Course`) were defined but simply never wired up in the switch.
- The bug-fixing commit `6eb8807d` makes exactly the minimal correction needed: replacing `Individual` with `Group`/`Curriculum`/`Course` respectively in each branch — a mirror image of the original copy-paste mistake, with no other logic changes.

No intervening commits altered these branches between introduction and fix (confirmed via `git log --follow` showing only 8 commits touched this file, none of which modified this switch logic before the fix). Confidence is high.
